name: antigravity-pt-br
description: Tradução completa da interface do Google Antigravity para Português do Brasil com suporte a Desktop e Mobile PWA (Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, iOS)

scripts.build: python3 generate_i18n.py && cp i18n-pt-br.js dist/ && cp patch-asar.js dist/ && cp cambrith-window-controls.js dist/ && cp icon.png dist/ && cp trayIcon*.png dist/ && cp mobile-bridge.js dist/ && cp qr-engine.js dist/ && cp mobile.sh dist/
scripts.lint: node -c patch-asar.js dist/patch-asar.js i18n-pt-br.js dist/i18n-pt-br.js mobile-bridge.js qr-engine.js tests/*.js

author: Enzo Campbell (Cambrith) <enzocampbell@outlook.com.br>
